newsitem.title: USA: Emisphere stake cut by Amerindo group.
newsitem.headline: Emisphere stake cut by Amerindo group.

text.p: A group led by San Francisco investment adviser Amerindo Investment Advisors Inc said Friday it cut its stake in Emisphere Technologies Inc to 1,107,300 common shares, or 11.69 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 100,200 common shares between February 11 and March 13 at prices ranging from $22.292 to $25.375 per share.
Emisphere, based in Hawthorne, NY., is a drug delivery company focused on the discovery and application of proprietary synthetic chemical compounds.
